recentItems.description:
सच का एक नया पहलू। 
गुलज़ार साहब की आवाज़ में। 

“Sach Ka Daayra” unfolds as a reflection of the unease that lingers at the film’s events, echoing
the angst, helplessness, and unanswered questions left in their wake. The song binds these
emotions into a musical expression of the story. At its core, Sach Ka Daayra asks just one question:
When the truth changes with perspective, where does the boundary of justice truly lie?
